translations.web: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.
translations.bsb: Then there are those who rebel against the light, not knowing its ways or staying on its paths.
translations.kjv: They are of those that rebel against the light; they know not the ways thereof, nor abide in the paths
translations.asv: These are of them that rebel against the light; They know not the ways thereof, Nor abide in the paths thereof.
